controls.requirement: Intended age audience, age assurance, parental/guardian flows, storefront age rating, and jurisdictional obligations are identified.
Generated and user-supplied content is evaluated for age-inappropriate, sexual, violent, self-harm, bullying, grooming, and manipulative behavior.
Collection, profiling, personalization, retention, deletion, location, contacts, voice, chat, and advertising minimize youth data and respect consent.
Chat, sharing, discovery, blocking, reporting, moderation, escalation, and evidence retention are safety-tested.
AI cannot expose hidden state, pressure purchases, bypass moderation, form unsafe relationships, or take consequential account/game actions without governed authority.
Safety incidents have human escalation, model/prompt disable controls, preservation rules, notification decisions, and corrective-action ownership.
